maintenance_led.reason: Home health, hospice and private duty nursing care services delivered to patients; not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Private duty nursing, home health and hospice are mostly paid by Medicaid and Medicare, including managed plans.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grew through some large acquisitions (e.g., Doctors Care, Thrive Skilled Pediatric Care), but now mainly organic growth.

mission_critical.reason: Medically fragile children and adults depend on continuous in-home nursing; switching providers risks care disruption and requires clinical handover.

notes: Payer mix and acquisition pace come from background knowledge, not the website text.
